svg.title: A panel discussion on a university stage under spotlights. A screen reads “The environmental footprint of digital technology — Panel discussion · School of Life and Environmental Sciences · University of Sydney”. Four speakers sit at a long table, each with a microphone and a name card: CEO, Politician, Researcher and Consumer. A gold label in front says “Moderator: you!”.

g.text: The environmental footprint of digital technology
